study: Prospectively fixed fine weighted eBOSS observed-random vs nine realistic EZmock-random n(z) audit
eligibility: finite coordinates (RA in [0,360), DEC in [-90,90]) and z in [0.6,1.0), finite positive combined weight after rejecting WEIGHT_SYSTOT <= 1e-12; fail on significantly negative weights within candidate
required_identity: SHA256 full observed FITS equals previously committed four observed-random SHA256; full compressed mock FITS equals 36 mock random SHA256 in successful pinned nine-mock ensemble JSON; earlier 3 mock input SHA pins checked again
chunk_policy: ELG CHUNK must exist in both observed and mock random FITS; normalize labels as decoded stripped text; compare only exact matching labels and report all nonmatching labels without pooling; do not assume identical chunk labels
predeclared_metrics: Per-cap, per-tracer normalized weighted forty-bin n(z), total weighted sum, Kish effective count
Unweighted forty-bin n(z) as a diagnostic
Weighted normalized total-variation distance and max absolute normalized bin difference for each fixed mock versus observed per cap and tracer
Per-cap ELG exact-label CHUNK weighted normalized forty-bin n(z) and weighted total-variation distance only on shared labels
Observed-versus-mock weighted four coarse z-bin fractions obtained by exact aggregation of the forty fine bins
Across all nine fixed mocks descriptive min, median, max by cap/tracer and per exactly shared chunk
status_scope: Local one-cap/one-id runs are pilot shards; only all nine IDs both caps can be called nine_mock_fine_weighted_nz_control_complete. These are window-input checks, not validated physical selection or odd-sector results.
resampling_or_tuning: No bin edges, subset of mocks, individual cap, chunk label, weight variant, or reporting threshold is chosen in response to any odd data vector or a large/small mock difference.
